camel_example: aliyun ossutil api put-bucket-inventory --bucket examplebucket --region cn-hangzhou --inventory-id report1
description_en: Configures an inventory rule for a specified bucket
description_zh: 为指定存储空间（Bucket）配置清单（Inventory）规则
name: PutBucketInventory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the inventory rule
parameters.name: inventory_id

fields.help_en: The custom inventory name. The inventory name must be unique within the current bucket
fields.help_zh: 自定义清单名称，清单名称在当前Bucket下必须唯一
fields.name: id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the inventory feature. Valid values:

- true: enables the inventory feature.
- false: does not enable the inventory feature
fields.help_zh:
是否启用清单功能。取值范围如下：

- true：启用清单功能。
- false：不启用清单功能
fields.name: is_enabled

fields.help_en: Valid values: CSV
fields.help_zh: 取值范围为CSV
fields.name: format

fields.help_en: The account ID granted by the bucket owner
fields.help_zh: Bucket所有者授予的账户ID
fields.name: account_id

fields.help_en: The name of the role that has permissions to read all objects from the source bucket and write objects to the destination bucket. Format: `acs:ram::uid:role/rolename`
fields.help_zh: 具有读取源Bucket所有文件和向目标Bucket写入文件权限的角色名，格式为`acs:ram::uid:role/rolename`
fields.name: role_arn

fields.help_en: The bucket that stores the exported inventory list
fields.help_zh: 存放导出的清单文件的Bucket
fields.name: bucket

fields.help_en: The storage path prefix of the inventory list
fields.help_zh: 清单文件的存储路径前缀
fields.name: prefix

fields.help_en: Uses an OSS fully managed key for encryption and decryption
fields.help_zh: 使用OSS完全托管密钥进行加解密
fields.name: sse_oss

fields.help_en: The KMS key ID
fields.help_zh: KMS密钥ID
fields.name: key_id

fields.help_en: The container that stores SSE-KMS encryption keys
fields.help_zh: 保存SSE-KMS加密密钥的容器
fields.name: sse_kms

fields.help_en: The encryption method of the inventory list file
fields.help_zh: 清单文件的加密方式
fields.name: encryption

fields.help_en: The bucket information for storing exported inventory results
fields.help_zh: 清单结果导出后存放的Bucket信息
fields.name: oss_bucket_destination

fields.help_en: The information about the destination where inventory results are stored
fields.help_zh: 存放清单结果的信息
fields.name: destination

fields.help_en:
The export cycle of inventory lists.

Valid values:
- Daily: Exports inventory lists on a daily basis.
- Weekly: Exports inventory lists on a weekly basis
fields.help_zh:
清单文件导出的周期。

有效值：
- Daily：按天导出清单文件。
- Weekly：按周导出清单文件
fields.name: frequency

fields.help_en: Contains the frequency that inventory lists are exported
fields.help_zh: Contains the frequency that inventory lists are exported
fields.name: schedule

fields.help_en: The matching prefix of the filter rule
fields.help_zh: 筛选规则的匹配前缀
fields.name: prefix

fields.help_en: The start timestamp for filtering objects by last modified time. Unit: seconds. Valid values: [1262275200, 253402271999]
fields.help_zh: 筛选文件最后修改时间的起始时间戳，单位为秒。  取值范围：[1262275200, 253402271999]
fields.name: last_modify_begin_time_stamp

fields.help_en: The end timestamp for filtering objects by last modified time. Unit: seconds. Valid values: [1262275200, 253402271999]
fields.help_zh: 筛选文件最后修改时间的终止时间戳，单位为秒。  取值范围：[1262275200, 253402271999]
fields.name: last_modify_end_time_stamp

fields.help_en: The minimum size of objects to filter. Unit: bytes. Valid values: greater than or equal to 0 bytes and less than or equal to 48.8 TB
fields.help_zh: 筛选文件的最小大小，单位为B。  取值范围：大于等于0 B，小于等于48.8 TB
fields.name: lower_size_bound

fields.help_en: The maximum size of objects to filter. Unit: bytes. Valid values: greater than 0 bytes and less than or equal to 48.8 TB
fields.help_zh: 筛选文件的最大大小，单位为B。  取值范围：大于0 B，小于等于48.8 TB
fields.name: upper_size_bound

fields.help_en:
The storage class of objects to filter. You can specify multiple storage classes. Valid values:
- Standard: Standard.
- IA: Infrequent Access.
- Archive: Archive.
- ColdArchive: Cold Archive.
- All (default): all storage classes
fields.help_zh: 筛选文件的存储类型，支持指定多种存储类型。  可选值：  Standard：标准存储  IA：低频访问  Archive：归档存储  ColdArchive：冷归档存储  All（默认值）：所有存储类型
fields.name: storage_class

fields.help_en: The prefix used for inventory filtering. After you specify a prefix, the inventory filters objects that match the prefix
fields.help_zh: 清单筛选的前缀。指定前缀后，清单将筛选出符合前缀设置的对象
fields.name: filter

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to include object version information in the inventory. Valid values:

- All: exports all version information of objects.

- Current: exports the current version information of objects
fields.help_zh:
是否在清单中包含Object版本信息。
取值范围如下：

- All：导出Object的所有版本信息。

- Current：导出Object的当前版本信息
fields.name: included_object_versions

fields.help_en:
清单结果中包含的配置项。
可选的配置项包括：

- Size：Object的大小。
- LastModifiedDate：Object的最后修改时间。
- ETag：Object的ETag值，用于标识Object的内容。
- StorageClass：Object的存储类型。
- IsMultipartUploaded：是否为通过分片上传方式上传的Object。
- EncryptionStatus：Object是否加密
fields.help_zh:
清单结果中包含的配置项。
可选的配置项包括：

- Size：Object的大小。
- LastModifiedDate：Object的最后修改时间。
- ETag：Object的ETag值，用于标识Object的内容。
- StorageClass：Object的存储类型。
- IsMultipartUploaded：是否为通过分片上传方式上传的Object。
- EncryptionStatus：Object是否加密
fields.name: field

fields.help_en: The list of configuration items included in the inventory results
fields.help_zh: 清单结果中包含的配置项列表
fields.name: optional_fields

fields.help_en: The IsEnabled
fields.help_zh: 增量清单是否启用
fields.name: is_enabled

fields.help_en: The Frequency
fields.help_zh: 描述增量清单文件导出的周期，单位为秒，目前固定为10分钟
fields.name: frequency

fields.help_en: The Schedule
fields.help_zh: 增量清单导出周期信息的容器
fields.name: schedule

fields.help_en: The Field
fields.help_zh: 增量清单导出字段列表
fields.name: field

fields.help_en: The OptionalFields
fields.help_zh: 增量清单文件属性的配置容器
fields.name: optional_fields

fields.help_en: The IncrementalInventory
fields.help_zh: 增量清单的配置容器
fields.name: incremental_inventory

parameters.help_en: The container that stores the inventory configuration information
parameters.help_zh: 存储清单配置信息的容器
parameters.name: inventory_configuration

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body that contains the inventory configuration information
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 存储清单配置信息的请求体
v1_body_parameters.name: body
